errors: Indexing is inconsistent: F_3 is written with a trailing Ob C_4 (four factors fixed), while the general F_n first carried '× Ob C_4', which was struck out. The general pattern F_k = Fl C_1 × … × Fl C_k × Ob C_{k+1} is not stated cleanly.
The low-degree terms are only half-formed. The top line (Ob C_4 → Fl_0(C_1), with a crossed arrow) and the gluing (Fl C_1 × Ob C_2) ⊔ … Fl_0(C_1) × Ob C_2 do not give a coherent F_0, F_1.

A product of cubical/1-dimensional cell complexes is not globular as it stands: a square cell has four 1-faces, not one source and one target. The proposed lexicographic F_k is a lax choice, and the needed identifications (collapsing) are not carried out on this page.
The join (O_1,F_1) * … * (O_n,F_n) and the extra factor '(?)' are left undefined.

ideas.what: Extracting a globular (s,t) cell structure from a product of categories or 1-dimensional complexes: k-cells = Fl C_1 × … × Fl C_k × Ob C_{k+1}
ideas.modern_name: globular vs cubical cells of products; lax/Gray-type tensor products; cubical-to-globular comparison
ideas.usually_credited_to: Gray (1974) for lax tensor products; Brown–Higgins, Crans, Al-Agl–Brown–Steiner for cubical/globular comparisons
ideas.where_published: Pursuing Stacks discusses globular models and products/cylinders informally; this specific formula is not known to me there

ideas.modern_name: pushout-product (Leibniz/box product) of inclusions; relative products of pairs
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard relative homotopy theory; formalised in model-category literature (e.g. Hovey, Joyal–Tierney)

ideas.what: (F × I) ⊔_{Ḟ×I} Ḟ: the cylinder with its boundary part collapsed, giving the globe D_{n+1} from D_n
ideas.modern_name: reduced cylinder / globular suspension; globes as quotients of cylinders
ideas.usually_credited_to: classical topology; in the globular setting Grothendieck (Pursuing Stacks 1983), later Batanin, Maltsiniotis, Ara
ideas.where_published: Pursuing Stacks (1983), discussion of standard globes/disks and Π_∞ of spaces

deep.surprise_reason: These are scratch computations toward globular models (globes from reduced cylinders, cells of products of categories) in the Pursuing Stacks circle of ideas. They are incomplete and contain nothing beyond what is known or standard.
transcription_corrections: The symbol at the top left read as '∐' is more likely two upward arrows ('↑↑'), a margin mark rather than a coproduct.
The arrow from Ob C_4 to Fl_0(C_1) on the first line is drawn with a crossing stroke and appears struck or overwritten.
The line 'Fl C_1 × Fl(C_2) × Ob C_3' shows a '2' overwritten by '1' in the first factor.
The label before 'Fl C_1 × Fl C_2 × Fl C_3 × Ob C_4' is written 'F_)'; F_3 is plausible.
In 'F_n = Fl C_1 × Fl C_2 — × Fl C_n', the dash denotes an ellipsis; the trailing '× Ob C_4' is struck through.
'O_2 ⊂ F_2' is written over a struck symbol; the last pair reads 'O_n ⊂ F_n'.
'Ḃ × I' under the coproduct should read 'Ḟ × I', and the final isolated symbol is a struck 'Ḟ'.
